# Credit curve (`credit-curve` v1)

CDS par spreads by tenor, recovery and implied default probabilities.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `CDS` · **Identifiers:** `CDS-…` in `curveId`

Open one with `CDS <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: credit-curve
version: 1
description: "CDS par spreads by tenor, recovery and implied default probabilities."
match: { kind: credit-curve, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Credit curve, id: $.curveId }
strip:
  - { label: Reference entity, bind: $.issuerName }
  - { label: "5Y spread", bind: $.spread5y, fmt: bp1, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Recovery, bind: $.recovery, fmt: pct0 }
  - { label: Seniority, bind: $.seniority }
  - { label: Doc clause, bind: $.docClause }
  - { label: "1Y PD", bind: $.pd1y, fmt: pct2 }
panels:
  - id: spreads
    kind: line
    title: Par spreads (bp)
    key: F2
    rows: $.points
    x: tenor
    y: spread
    fmt: price2
  - id: points
    kind: table
    title: Term structure
    key: F3
    rows: $.points
    columns:
      - { label: Tenor, bind: "@.tenor" }
      - { label: Spread (bp), bind: "@.spread", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: Hazard, bind: "@.hazard", fmt: pct2 }
      - { label: Survival, bind: "@.survival", fmt: df4 }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.issuer, 'issuer')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
